تعتصمي (form VIII)
# تَعْتَصِمِي (taʕtaṣimī) /taʕ.ta.sˤi.miː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
# تُعْتَصَمِي (tuʕtaṣamī) /tuʕ.ta.sˤa.miː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
